notizie.titolo: Basel Committee finalises measures to address window-dressing in the G-SIB framework and consults on G-SIB methodology review
notizie.descrizione: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision today published final amendments to address window dressing in the G-SIB framework and a consultation on the G-SIB methodology review.

notizie.titolo: Global standard-setting bodies publish final report on guidance for FMIs on general business risks and general business losses
notizie.descrizione: The Bank for International Settlements’ Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures (CPMI) and the International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) today published a final report on financial market infrastructures’ (FMIs) management of general business risks and general business losses.

notizie.titolo: Basel Committee finds Australia, Japan, Korea, Switzerland compliant, and Canada, United Kingdom largely compliant with its leverage ratio framework
notizie.descrizione: The Basel Committee has published assessment reports on the implementation of its leverage ratio framework (LEV) in Australia, Canada, Japan, Korea, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Australia, Japan, Korea and Switzerland are assessed as compliant; Canada and the United Kingdom are assessed as largely compliant. This publication concludes the first round of multi-jurisdictional assessments of the leverage ratio.

notizie.titolo: Basel III applicable in almost all member jurisdictions by 2027
notizie.descrizione: Three quarters of the Basel Committee’s 27 member jurisdictions have now published regulations implementing the full set of Basel III standards. Almost all member jurisdictions have publicly announced that banks must apply Basel III by April 2027 or earlier. The Committee will continue to closely monitor and assess the full and consistent implementation of Basel III standards.

notizie.titolo: Basel Committee meets to advance supervisory and regulatory initiatives and discuss risks and vulnerabilities to the global banking system
notizie.descrizione: Exchanges experiences and views on developments in artificial intelligence for the global banking system and supervisors, modernisation efforts and implications for the Committee’s future work programme...

notizie.titolo: International supervisory community meets to discuss the future of global bank supervision and regulation
notizie.descrizione: Almost 300 central bankers and banking supervisors attended the International Conference of Banking Supervisors (ICBS) to discuss the future of supervision and the digitalisation of finance...

notizie.titolo: Basel III risk-based capital and leverage ratios are stable while liquidity indicators show limited movements for large internationally active banks, latest Basel III monitoring exercise shows
notizie.descrizione: As of the end of 2025, Basel III risk-based capital and leverage ratios remained stable for large internationally active banks compared with June 2025.

notizie.titolo: Global standard-setting bodies publish a toolkit for cyber resilience at FMIs and a discussion paper on FMIs’ reliance on third-party service providers
notizie.descrizione: CPMI-IOSCO are seeking input from stakeholders on a cyber resilience toolkit for financial market infrastructures (FMIs) and on risks to FMIs from third-party service providers. The Cyber resilience toolkit: practical considerations for FMIs supports FMIs in strengthening their cyber resilience frameworks. The discussion paper FMIs’ reliance on third-party service providers: challenges and risks explores the increased reliance of FMIs on third-party service providers.

notizie.titolo: Global economic pressure points call for policy discipline: BIS
notizie.descrizione: The sustainability of the AI boom, financial vulnerabilities and strained public finances are among pressure points facing the global economy, along with the return of inflation.

notizie.titolo: The path to the next-generation monetary and financial system lies in safeguarding trust in money: BIS
notizie.descrizione: Digital innovation is transforming finance, potentially enabling greater competition and efficiency in payment systems and financial intermediation. However, it also poses new macro-financial challenges and raises the broader question of how to preserve trust in money in the digital age.

notizie.titolo: Bank liquidity regulation and the growth of private credit
notizie.descrizione: We study the role of bank liquidity regulation in the growth of private credit. Following the introduction of the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR), private credit increases significantly more in U.S. counties with a larger footprint of banks subject to the LCR or of LCR banks with greater initial liquidity shortfalls.

notizie.titolo: Central banks and macro financial stability in a fragmented global economy
notizie.descrizione: The 25th BIS Annual Conference took place in Basel, Switzerland on 26 June 2026. The event brought together a distinguished group of central bank Governors, leading academics and former public officials to exchange views on the theme “Central banks and macro-financial stability in a fragmented global economy”.

notizie.titolo: Inflation after the Iran war
notizie.descrizione: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy.

notizie.titolo: Competing rails for crossborder payments: banks, fintechs, and stablecoins
notizie.descrizione: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive despite significant improvements in digital financial infrastructure over the past several decades.

notizie.titolo: Geoeconomic pressure
notizie.descrizione: The increasing use of geoeconomic pressure is reshaping the global economy.

notizie.titolo: Offshore forwards and exchange rate transmission in emerging markets
notizie.descrizione: We study how offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) markets transmit exchange-rate pressures to domestic currency markets. Using unique transaction-level data on the universe of centrally cleared NDFs for ten emerging-market currencies over 2013–2025, we show that offshore NDF order flow moves both offshore forward and domestic spot exchange rates and widens the offshore–onshore forward spread.

notizie.titolo: Chokepoint disruptions and their macroeconomic consequences
notizie.descrizione: Rising geopolitical tensions, including trade restrictions and conflicts, are increasingly disrupting global supply chains, posing significant risks at critical chokepoints. Strong substitution effects and the use of inventories have helped to mitigate adverse output effects of chokepoint disruptions, but they often come at the cost of higher input prices. An effective policy response to chokepoint disruptions requires a tailored approach that takes account of the cause, centrality and the private sector’s ability to substitute and draw on buffers.

notizie.titolo: Money and the architecture of trust
notizie.descrizione: Money is one of the most consequential social institutions humanity has built. Starting from the most elementary monetary act, a payment, this paper provides an account of how money works, grounded in the tradition of credit theories of money.

notizie.titolo: Are stablecoins and bank deposits substitutes?
notizie.descrizione: We test whether stablecoins and bank deposits act as substitutes by estimating the semi-elasticity of stablecoin market capitalization with respect to deposit rate changes. Using local projections fit to weekly U.S. data from January 2019 to June 2025, we find that deposit rate increases predict slower stablecoin growth. To address endogeneity, we exploit a nonlinearity in deposit rate pass-through.

notizie.titolo: Transformative AI and demand bottlenecks
notizie.descrizione: Transformative AI promises to accelerate growth through productivity enhancement and automation. Yet automation on such a scale would raise the share of investment in output, potentially starving AI innovation of returns from a shrinking consumer market.

notizie.titolo: Artificial intelligence and climate change: balancing innovation and sustainability
notizie.descrizione: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly important factor in the climate transition. AI can improve energy efficiency, optimise resource use, accelerate climate innovation and strengthen climate forecasting, adaptation and risk management. At the same time, the development and deployment of AI require substantial computational resources, increasing electricity demand and, depending on the carbon intensity and timing of electricity use, associated emissions.

notizie.titolo: Chasing El Dorado: gold under shifting geopolitical and financial conditions
notizie.descrizione: This paper analyses the state-dependent effects of geopolitical risks on gold prices (i.e. the safe-haven role of gold), conditional on financial conditions. Geopolitical risks are often associated with tighter financial conditions. However, recent data reveal a decoupling between such shocks and more restrictive financial conditions, raising the question of how gold returns are affected by geopolitical shocks, conditional on the macro-financial environment.

notizie.titolo: Circular relationships among AI firms
notizie.descrizione: Between 2021 and 2025, 28.7% of artificial intelligence (AI) firms’ investment deals (by deal value) involved a target company that was also an AI firm, while 55.2% of incoming investments in AI firms came from other AI firms.

notizie.titolo: Core Principles for Effective Deposit Insurance Systems – Executive Summary
notizie.descrizione: The Core Principles for Effective Deposit Insurance Systems (core principles) of the International Association of Deposit Insurers are the international standard for the design, implementation and assessment of deposit insurance systems. They provide a benchmark for jurisdictions to evaluate and enhance their deposit insurance frameworks, with the dual objectives of safeguarding depositors and promoting financial stability.

notizie.titolo: High public debt, NBFIs and the risk of market dysfunction
notizie.descrizione: Near record-high government debt levels and the growing role of non-banks have reshaped government debt markets in recent years. High levels of government sector debt are expected to worsen future government debt market liquidity conditions in general, including by increasing the risk of market dysfunction. A large non-bank financial institution footprint heightens the risk of market dysfunction while also making very favourable liquidity conditions more likely.

notizie.titolo: The leverage ratio and the output floor: complementarities and overlaps
notizie.descrizione: This paper examines analytically and empirically whether the Basel III leverage ratio (LR) and output floor (OF) requirements act as substitutes for or complements to each other and how they interact with risk‑based regulatory requirements.

notizie.titolo: Trusted execution environments for central banks
notizie.descrizione: This paper considers what TEEs can responsibly deliver for central banks, the conditions under which they are most effective and how they can be deployed without widening who must be trusted. It takes a balanced view, outlining core assurances and boundaries, highlighting implementation and governance dependencies and situating TEEs alongside alternative approaches to confidential computing.

notizie.titolo: Old workers, young machines: can AI and automation offset population ageing?
notizie.descrizione: Key takeawaysArtificial intelligence (AI) and robots have the potential to offset the macroeconomic consequences of an ageing workforce, but the ability to automate jobs depends on which industries are ageing.AI and robots substitute most readily for jobs in industries with younger workforces (eg finance), while older, high-employment industries (eg agriculture, health) have less scope for automation.A new ageing–automation scorecard for over 130 economies shows that some of the fastest-ageing…

notizie.titolo: Unraveling the cobweb of global imbalances: drivers, vulnerabilities, and adjustment scenarios
notizie.descrizione: This paper analyses the evolution and drivers of the stock of global imbalances in order to assess associated vulnerabilities and potential adjustment scenarios. These imbalances have recently increased sharply, with a deterioration in the US net international investment position (NIIP) mirrored by NIIP improvements in most other major economies.

notizie.titolo: Maritime chokepoints and the global economy: evidence from the Strait of Hormuz
notizie.descrizione: The conflict in the Middle East and the subsequent disruption of traffic in the Strait of Hormuz have triggered an unprecedented shock to the global economy. Using historical data from the IMF/University of Oxford Portwatch database on maritime traffic, this paper empirically examines some of the potential economic and financial consequences of disruptions to traffic in the Strait of Hormuz.
